traceAs.run/steps.cjs: every hook handler (start, prompt, touched, compact) and every verb (handoff, keep, show, drop) as one traced step of its own name
traceAs.steps/session.cjs: inside the traced steps start, prompt, touched and compact
traceAs.steps/verbs.cjs: inside the traced steps handoff, keep, show and drop
traceAs.steps/facts.cjs: inside the traced steps that rebuild the note: handoff, keep and compact
traceAs.steps/store.cjs: the one reader and writer of the home folder, inside every step that reads or writes a note or a session
